Four Easy Ways to Cater

Weddings, rehearsal dinners, corporate retreats, fundraisers, family events, school and sports teams. We have done them all. Our food is fresh and prepped daily, and our most popular order is a pickup or delivered taco or fajita bar: perfect for beach house rentals, corporate meetings and school groups.

  • Pickup

    Pick up your order at either Tio's location at a designated time.

  • Delivery

    Orders over $500

    Direct delivery is available for catering orders over $500. A $50 delivery fee applies to orders between $500 and $999, and a $100 delivery fee to orders over $1,000.

  • In-House Private Events

    12+ guests

    Birthdays, rehearsal dinners, anniversaries, baby showers and group get-togethers. Both locations have designated areas for set menus, buffets, tapas and plated dinners. A 20% gratuity is added to any party of 6 or more.

  • Full-Service Catering

    Delivery to your location with Tio's staff to set up, maintain and clean up the buffet. Includes chafing stands and canned heat.

Catering FAQ

What types of events does Tio's cater?

All, any and every type! Weddings, dress rehearsals, corporate retreats, fundraisers, family events, school and sports teams. We offer over 10 different protein styles, customized for your crowd. We do have minimum orders during our busier seasons.

How do I get a quote for my event?

Complete the quote form on this page. Once our event coordinator has some initial information, she will call you at a designated time. Once the details are ironed out, an invoice is sent for signature, approval and a deposit if necessary.

How far in advance should I reserve my date?

As soon as possible. We only book 1 to 2 events per day so our focus and attention is on your event, and reservations are taken on a first come basis. We prefer events to be confirmed 2 weeks in advance, but we will do our best to accommodate last minute orders, especially for memorials and celebrations of life.

Do you offer just delivery or drop-off?

Yes, and it is our most popular service. A delivery charge covers fuel and staff time and is based on the distance to your event, the logistics of unloading, the amount of setup requested and whether we return to pick up equipment. If an event is over 15 miles from the closest restaurant, supplemental travel costs apply for event staff.

Are chafing dishes, plates and utensils included?

Pickup and delivery orders come in disposable foil pans. Full-service catering includes chafing dishes and canned heat. Disposable plates, napkins, cutlery and serving utensils are available for an additional charge.

Can I customize the menu or accommodate dietary restrictions?

Absolutely. We love to create a menu specifically for your event. Gluten free, vegan, lactose free: just let us know, and please tell us about any food allergies.

Do you offer tastings?

Yes. Tastings are $30 per person and are based on the suggested menu in your proposal. If you book with us, the cost of the tasting is applied toward your event.

Do you provide wine or liquor?

Both restaurant locations have a full liquor license and can provide specialized menus for private events on site. We cannot provide alcohol at an offsite event, but we can provide our in-house fresh margarita mix so you can make our margaritas yourselves.

What is your deposit and cancellation policy?

A deposit is required for any order over $250, with the remaining balance due the day of the event. Deposits are refunded in full for cancellations seven or more days before the event, 50% from six days to 48 hours before, and are not refunded within 48 hours of the event.

Are you insured?

Yes. Tio's Latin American Kitchen is fully insured. We hold a $1 million liability policy and all of our vehicles are commercially insured.

Prices listed are per person and are subject to change without notice. Delivery, gratuity and service charges may apply.
